title: Invoicing & payments Create & Edit lets the user create invoices and take payments
custom_preconds:
1. See Financial Data ON.
  2. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View and Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and create an invoice.
  2. Take a payment on a part sale.
  3. Change an invoice field.
evidence: UI (Service Advisor, Invoicing Create&Edit): the WO Finance tab shows Create Invoice + Add Deposit actions (create invoices/take payments). screenshot inv-invCE.
